cc:Work.dc:title: Countercurrent versus co-current exchange
cc:Work.dc:description: With the same inlets and exchanger, countercurrent flow keeps a 3 kPa gradient along the whole lamella so blood leaves at 17 kPa; co-current flow loses its gradient and blood leaves at 11 kPa, equal to the water outlet.
